thread:
Leah CS: Heads-up — AeroSync just signed up two more squads (Support + Legal) for the multi-service inbox pilot. They rolled a small change into dev this morning and we saw ~3x qps vs last week. They want realtime triage + concise summaries + reranking across channels.

Ravi SE: Nice, congrats. Do they want a Dedicated pod or are they asking to just burst on hosted for now?

Leah CS: They explicitly asked about Dedicated GPU pools for predictable latency and data isolation. Renewal conversation is ~90 days out; they said scaling reliability is a make-or-break for org-wide rollout.

Maya CSE: Can we get a short health-check playbook ready? I can run an enablement session for the Support squad next Wed.

Dmitri Eng: Quick Q: what's their observed request shape? seq lengths / concurrency / regen rates? If it's mostly short messages we can lean on batching + KV prefix cache.

Leah CS: From their dev logs: avg seq ~120 tokens, typical short exchanges but some long summaries; peak burst ~18 req/s per user during test scripts; concurrent ~80 connections across the two squads. They want <300ms p95 for replies.

Dmitri Eng: 300ms p95 at that concurrency will likely need Dedicated + caching/quantization. I can propose an infra config: reserved pods, autoscale with fast burst. Also call out prefix/KV cache and ensuring we avoid cold KV misses.

Oliver SRE: tagging @deploy-bot to open a capacity pilot ticket and reserve engineering slots for testing.

deploy-bot: Ticket #CS-4821 created — aero-sync-dedicated-pilot — assignee: eng-runtime — priority: high — ETA: 72h.

Ravi SE: Also capture Legal's ask for VPC/private option — they flagged PII concerns and want encryption + audit trail. Could be a blocker for the full rollout.

Leah CS: We'll run enablement and collect prompt/eval sets during the pilot. They also asked for per-route cost breakdown and live tracing during the pilot so they can model unit economics for each inbox route. Product/analytics input needed.

Maya CSE: I'll create a shared doc and schedule a 1:1 with AeroSync SRE to go over integration points and dataflow (Tues afternoon).

Dmitri Eng: Dropping a config suggestion to start with (will follow up in ticket): `desired_pods: 2`, `min_gpu: 2`, `burst_capacity: 1.5x`, `kv_cache: enabled`, `quantize: int8`, `max_concurrency_per_pod: 100`.

Ravi SE: Perfect — I'll loop Sales into the renewal plan and map pricing options for Dedicated vs Private. Also capturing feature ask: per-route cost UI and traceable token-level metrics.

Leah CS: Thanks team :thumbsup: — this is a clear expansion signal. I'll send a customer recap after the call and add the account to the high-touch renewal tracker. Anything else we should surface now?
